breakpoint.$description: Widths the layout steps at, stored in px and named by value. Media queries (the window) and container queries (the column) both use them. The build writes them to Sass in rem (1350px becomes 84.375rem). They have no CSS custom properties. At the default text size a breakpoint is the same width in both kinds of query. Because :root is fixed at 16px, a reader who changes the browser's text size moves the media queries but not the container queries.
